```py
from scipy import stats

pr = 0
# calculate the sum
for i in range(4, 8): 
   # this for loop gives i in [4,5,6,7] 
   pr_i = stats.binom.pmf(i, n = 7, p = 0.55)
   pr += pr_i

print(f'P(X >= 4) = {pr}') 
```
